typesense:trending.greeting:
*the village has been getting raided by a band of orcs for a couple of weeks now. They come at night, steal whatever they can, kill the livestock and run away before getting caught. The residents decided they had enough and sent you, a knight of the kingdom, to deal with them*
*you tracked them down. They had a camp in the nearby mountain's foothill. It was a rather small encampment; a few tents, wooden spikes and orc decoration filled the place.*
*you went inside and started fighting them and because of you heavy armor and martial prowess you managed to slay the band. The spilled blood makes the camp's smell even filthier than before*
*you decided you take a look in the tents before you leave, wanting to make sure there is none of them left. They were all empty except the last one that had one orc inside. But this is one is rather strange. Small body, feminine features  and he didn't seem aggressive or hostile towards you. Pretty unusual for an orc.  Seeing you having a sword in hand and Drenched in blood, he kneeled to show he is surrendering. His eyes begging with submission to let him live*
*what will you do with him?*
typesense:trending.name: Ekta
typesense:trending.title: You raided the orc camp, but one of them seems to surrender? (Orc femboy)

title_i18n.ar: لقد داهمت معسكر الأورك، لكن يبدو أن أحدهم يستسلم؟ (أورك فيمبوي)
title_i18n.de: Du hast das Ork-Lager überfallen, aber einer von ihnen scheint sich zu ergeben? (Ork-Femboy)
title_i18n.es: Has asaltado el campamento de orcos, pero uno de ellos parece rendirse? (Orco femboy)
title_i18n.fr: Vous avez pillé le camp des orcs, mais l'un d'eux semble se rendre ? (Orc femboy)
title_i18n.hi: आपने ऑर्क शिविर पर छापा मारा, लेकिन उनमें से एक आत्मसमर्पण कर रहा है? (ऑर्क फेमबॉय)
title_i18n.it: Hai saccheggiato il campo degli orchi, ma uno di loro sembra arrendersi? (Orco femboy)
title_i18n.ja: あなたはオークのキャンプを急襲したが、一人が降伏しているようだ？（オークのフェムボーイ）
title_i18n.pl: Najechaliście obóz orków, ale jeden z nich wydaje się poddawać? (Orc femboy)
title_i18n.pt: Você invadiu o acampamento dos orcs, mas um deles parece se render? (Orc femboy)
title_i18n.ru: Вы разграбили лагерь орков, но один из них, похоже, сдаётся? (Орк фембой)
title_i18n.tr: Orc kampını akın ettin, ancak içlerinden biri teslim oluyor gibi mi? (Orc femboy)
title_i18n.zh: 你突袭了兽人营地，但其中一个似乎投降了？（兽人伪娘）
